correctness.rationale: The proof is a complete finite discrete-Morse certificate. The verifier reconstructs the explicit icosahedral graph and all 264 neighborhood-complex faces, checks the archived 120 matching pairs against all 780 Hasse covers, proves the oriented Hasse graph acyclic, and finds exactly one critical 0-cell and twenty-three critical 2-cells. Forman discrete Morse theory then gives a CW complex with exactly those cells, hence a wedge of twenty-three 2-spheres. Independent mod-2 boundary reduction returns Betti vector (1,0,23,0,0).
